section_summary: This section begins with confidential exchanges between the State Department, Navy Department and Netherlands Legation about oil shipments to Japan and purchases for the Japanese Navy. It then follows requests for Japanese transports and training ships to visit U.S. ports, the circulation of those requests to federal and state authorities, and replies granting the usual courtesies. Several later notes revise proposed sailing schedules.

people.role: Admiral; Acting Secretary of the Navy

people.name: John Hickerson
people.role: Acting Chief, Division of European Affairs

people.name: H. M. van Haersma de With

subfiles.title: Forwarding Netherlands proposal for oil-information exchange
subfiles.about: Forwards the Netherlands chargé’s proposal to exchange monthly information on Japanese Navy oil purchases.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Netherlands chargé’s proposal for a monthly exchange of Japanese Navy oil-purchase figures.

subfiles.title: Reply to Netherlands chargé on oil-information exchange
subfiles.about: Accepts the proposed monthly exchange, subject to receiving U.S. figures from the Navy Department.
subfiles.summary: Hickerson promises to transmit monthly U.S. purchase data received from the Navy Department.

subfiles.title: Navy agreement to exchange oil statistics
subfiles.about: Agrees to exchange confidential oil-shipment figures with the Netherlands Legation.
subfiles.summary: The Navy agrees to monthly exchanges and encloses its latest figures for August and September 1937.

subfiles.title: U.S. oil shipments for the Japanese Navy, August–September 1937
subfiles.about: Lists estimated oil shipments by type and month.
subfiles.summary: Estimated Japanese Navy shipments total 639,931 barrels in August and 577,885 in September.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Navy oil figures
subfiles.to: Claude A. Swanson, Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the figures and reports that they were forwarded to the Netherlands chargé.
subfiles.summary: Wilson forwards the figures and awaits corresponding Netherlands East Indies statistics.

subfiles.title: Transmission of Navy oil figures to Netherlands chargé
subfiles.about: Sends U.S. oil-shipment figures and requests corresponding Netherlands East Indies figures.
subfiles.summary: Sends the August–September table and requests Japanese Navy oil-purchase information from the Netherlands East Indies.

subfiles.title: Netherlands acknowledgment of U.S. oil figures
subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of the U.S. figures and says they were sent to the Netherlands government.
subfiles.summary: The chargé hopes to receive corresponding Netherlands East Indies information soon.

subfiles.title: Netherlands transmission of oil-export figures
subfiles.about: Encloses figures for oil shipped from the Netherlands Indies to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Transmits export figures, including amounts shipped for the Japanese Navy.

subfiles.title: Netherlands Indies oil exports to Japan
subfiles.about: Breaks down oil exports to Japan for 1936 and 1937, including Japanese Navy fuel oil.
subfiles.summary: Lists total oil and gasoline exports and Japanese Navy fuel oil for 1936 and portions of 1937.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Netherlands oil-export figures
subfiles.to: H. M. van Haersma de With
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Netherlands Indies figures and reports their confidential transmission to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: The State Department acknowledges the table and says it has sent the information to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Netherlands Indies oil figures to Navy
subfiles.to: Claude A. Swanson, Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards Netherlands Indies oil-shipment figures to the Navy Department.
subfiles.summary: Hull sends the Netherlands figures, including quantities for the Japanese Navy.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission of updated U.S. oil figures
subfiles.about: Sends updated figures for onward transmission to the Netherlands Legation.
subfiles.summary: Leahy forwards the Navy’s latest available oil-shipment information.

subfiles.title: U.S. oil shipments to Japan, December 1937 and annual totals
subfiles.about: Lists shipments by oil type and explains that Japanese Navy deliveries cannot be isolated accurately.
subfiles.summary: Reports gross shipments to Japanese ports; future reports will use this measure because Navy-specific quantities cannot be determined accurately.

subfiles.title: Transmission of updated oil figures to Netherlands chargé
subfiles.about: Sends the Navy’s updated confidential memorandum on oil shipments to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the latest Navy memorandum on U.S. oil shipments to Japan.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Navy oil memorandum
subfiles.to: Claude A. Swanson, Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Navy memorandum and confirms its confidential transmission to the Netherlands chargé.
subfiles.summary: Hull confirms forwarding the memorandum to the Netherlands chargé.

subfiles.title: Proposed visits of Hayatomo, Ondo and Iroo
subfiles.about: Requests approval and customary courtesies for three transports visiting Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The transports seek crude petroleum at Los Angeles and water and food at Honolulu on schedules from April through July.

subfiles.title: Notice to Governor of California on transport visits
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for the three Japanese transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays their Los Angeles and Honolulu schedules and requests usual facilities if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Japanese transport request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the transport request while awaiting replies from U.S. authorities.
subfiles.summary: The State Department has asked relevant authorities about the proposed visits and will report their replies.

subfiles.title: Request to Navy on transport visits
subfiles.about: Requests Navy consideration and customary courtesies for the three transports.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note and asks the Navy to arrange usual courtesies if it has no objection.

subfiles.title: Request to Agriculture on transport visits
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for the three transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays the vessels’ proposed Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor on transport visits
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for the three transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays their schedules and requests usual courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury on transport visits
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for the three transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays their schedules for Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Request to War on transport visits
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for the three transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays the planned calls and asks for usual facilities if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Immigration reply on transport visits
subfiles.about: Reports instructions to immigration officers at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Local officers will extend courtesies consistent with immigration laws and regulations.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission of further oil figures
subfiles.about: Sends further oil-shipment figures for the Netherlands Legation.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the latest available figures for confidential transmission.

subfiles.title: U.S. oil shipments to Japan, January–February 1938
subfiles.about: Tabulates U.S. oil shipments to Japan by oil type for January and February 1938.
subfiles.summary: Lists monthly crude oil, gasoline, lubricating oil, gas and fuel oil, and totals.

subfiles.title: Transmission of further oil figures to Netherlands chargé
subfiles.about: Encloses the Navy’s latest confidential oil-shipment memorandum.
subfiles.summary: Sends updated figures for U.S. oil shipments to Japan.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of further Navy oil figures
subfiles.to: Claude A. Swanson, Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Confirms that the latest Navy oil figures were sent to the Netherlands chargé.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the Navy memorandum and confirms its confidential forwarding.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on transport visits
subfiles.about: Reports instructions to Army commands concerning the transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Commands in California and Hawaii have instructions to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on transport visits
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies for the three transports.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Los Angeles and Honolulu will provide usual customs facilities.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on transport visits
subfiles.about: States the Navy has no objection to the visits.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend usual courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Approval of transport visits
subfiles.about: Approves the Hayatomo, Ondo and Iroo visits.
subfiles.summary: Federal authorities approve the proposed calls and will extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Netherlands oil-export update
subfiles.about: Provides Netherlands Indies oil-export figures for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Reports petroleum and gasoline exports, including petroleum destined for the Japanese Navy.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Netherlands oil-export update to Navy
subfiles.to: Claude A. Swanson, Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards updated Netherlands Indies oil figures.
subfiles.summary: Sends figures received from the Netherlands chargé, including Japanese Navy shipments.

subfiles.title: Netherlands acknowledgment of April oil figures
subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of U.S. oil-shipment figures.
subfiles.summary: The chargé says he forwarded the confidential Navy memorandum to his government.

subfiles.title: Netherlands acknowledgment of earlier oil memorandum
subfiles.about: Acknowledges an earlier confidential U.S. oil-shipment memorandum.
subfiles.summary: The Legation confirms transmitting the memorandum to its government.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Netherlands oil figures
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Netherlands Indies oil figures and confirms their transmission to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Moffat confirms that the figures were sent to the Navy in confidence.

subfiles.title: Proposed Nihon Maru training cruise visits
subfiles.about: Requests approval for Nihon Maru to call at Seattle and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese sailing training ship proposes Seattle and Honolulu calls in June and July. Captain Takaharu Nagata commands its crew, teachers and students; weather could alter the schedule.

subfiles.title: Request to Navy on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests Navy consideration and courtesies for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note on planned Seattle and Honolulu visits.

subfiles.title: Request to Governor of Washington on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Nihon Maru’s Seattle visit.
subfiles.summary: Relays the training ship’s schedule and complement.

subfiles.title: Request to Agriculture on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual facilities for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Describes the training cruise, proposed calls and ship’s complement.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual facilities for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Relays the Seattle and Honolulu schedule and personnel details.

subfiles.title: Request to Interior on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Describes the proposed training-ship visits.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual facilities for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Relays the ship’s planned Seattle and Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Request to War on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Describes the proposed visits and ship’s complement.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Nihon Maru request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Nihon Maru request while awaiting authorities’ replies.
subfiles.summary: The State Department will advise whether the visits are approved after receiving replies.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Reports Army instructions for the proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Army commands in California and Hawaii were told to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Immigration reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.from: Edw. J. Shaughnessy, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: Reports instructions to immigration offices at Seattle and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Personnel will receive courtesies consistent with immigration rules.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: States the Navy has no objection to Nihon Maru’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend usual courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Approval of Nihon Maru visits
subfiles.about: Approves Nihon Maru’s Seattle and Honolulu visits.
subfiles.summary: Federal departments agree to the visits and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Washington State reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Conveys Governor Martin’s welcome for Nihon Maru’s Seattle visit.
subfiles.summary: Washington will extend usual courtesies; Seattle’s mayor has been notified.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies for Nihon Maru.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Seattle and Honolulu will provide customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Revised Seattle dates for Nihon Maru
subfiles.about: Changes Nihon Maru’s Seattle call to June 10–20.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador asks that usual courtesies continue despite the revised dates.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy of revised Nihon Maru dates
subfiles.about: Notifies the Navy that Nihon Maru’s Seattle schedule has changed.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note revising the Seattle call to June 10–20.

subfiles.title: Proposed Kaioh Maru visit to San Diego
subfiles.about: Requests approval and customary courtesies for Kaioh Maru at San Diego.
subfiles.summary: The sailing training ship proposes a June 30–July 7 call. Captain Nojiro Haneda commands its crew, teachers and students; weather may alter the dates.

subfiles.title: Request to Governor of California on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Kaioh Maru’s San Diego visit.
subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed dates and ship’s complement.

subfiles.title: Request to Navy on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Requests Navy consideration and courtesies for Kaioh Maru.
subfiles.summary: Describes the San Diego visit and personnel.

subfiles.title: Request to Agriculture on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for Kaioh Maru.
subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed San Diego visit.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for Kaioh Maru.
subfiles.summary: Describes its schedule and complement.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for Kaioh Maru.
subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed San Diego call.

subfiles.title: Request to War on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Kaioh Maru.
subfiles.summary: Describes the planned visit and ship’s complement.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Kaioh Maru request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the request while consulting U.S. authorities.
subfiles.summary: The State Department will advise whether the visit is approved after replies arrive.

subfiles.title: Immigration reply on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.from: Edw. J. Shaughnessy, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: Reports instructions for immigration courtesies at San Diego.
subfiles.summary: The Los Angeles district director will arrange courtesies consistent with immigration rules.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Reports Army instructions for Kaioh Maru’s San Diego visit.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area has instructions to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies at San Diego.
subfiles.summary: The collector will provide customary facilities for Kaioh Maru.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on Kaioh Maru
subfiles.about: States the Navy has no objection to Kaioh Maru’s visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities have been notified to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Approval of Kaioh Maru visit
subfiles.about: Approves Kaioh Maru’s San Diego visit.
subfiles.summary: The vessel will receive customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Iroo schedule change and proposed Manila visit
subfiles.about: Defers Iroo’s Los Angeles and Honolulu calls and requests a Manila call.
subfiles.summary: Iroo’s U.S. port calls move from July to October. Under Colonel Noboru Ishizaki, it proposes Manila on July 4–8 for water and food.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy on Iroo schedule change
subfiles.about: Reports Iroo’s revised itinerary and proposed Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: The Los Angeles and Honolulu calls move to October; Manila is proposed for July 4–8.

subfiles.title: Request to War on Iroo’s Manila visit
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Iroo’s proposed Manila call.
subfiles.summary: Relays the postponed U.S. calls and proposed Manila provisioning stop.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Iroo’s revised itinerary
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Iroo’s revised plans and consultations with federal departments.
subfiles.summary: The State Department is seeking customary facilities for the proposed Manila visit.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Iroo’s schedule changes
subfiles.about: States that the Navy has no objection to Iroo’s revised itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities have been advised of the Manila visit and deferred U.S. calls.

subfiles.title: Proposed Taisei Maru visit to Portland
subfiles.about: Requests approval and courtesies for Taisei Maru’s Portland visit.
subfiles.summary: The Tokyo training ship proposes an August 5–13 call under Captain Naraji Ono.

subfiles.title: Request to Governor of Oregon on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Taisei Maru at Portland.
subfiles.summary: Relays the training ship’s proposed dates and complement.

subfiles.title: Request to Agriculture on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for Taisei Maru’s Portland call.
subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed visit and ship’s complement.
